title: Greener Synthesis of 4‑Selanyl-Isocoumarins Mediated by TCCA: Electrochemical Insights and DNA Interaction Studies.
authors: Welter, Luiz Eduardo; Baptista, Marcelo; Nicoleti, Celso Rodrigo; Gomes, Suzane Quintana; Miranda, Fabio S; da Silva, Suelen Santos; Frizon, Tiago Elias A; Braga, Antonio Luiz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机合成与DNA结合实验，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: We present a straightforward and sustainable approach for the synthesis of 4-selanyl-isocoumarins from 2-(alkynyl)-aryl or -heteroaryl and diorganoyl diselenides. This transformation employs trichloroisocyanuric acid (TCCA) as a low-cost, metal-free oxidant under ambient conditions, delivering the desired products in yields of up to 98%. Mechanistic investigations support an electrophilic activation of the alkyne followed by a 6-endo-dig cyclization. Electrochemical and DFT analyses confirm the redox activity and structural stability of the resulting compounds. Additionally, DNA binding studies, combining UV-vis spectroscopy and molecular docking, reveal dual interaction modes (intercalation and groove binding), underscoring their potential in DNA-targeted drug design.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种从2-(炔基)-芳基或杂芳基与二有机酰基二硒化物合成4-硒基异香豆素的简便且可持续的方法。该转化使用三氯异氰尿酸（TCCA）作为低成本、无金属氧化剂，在环境条件下进行，目标产物的产率高达98%。机理研究支持炔烃的亲电活化，随后发生6-endo-dig环化。电化学和DFT分析确认了所得化合物的氧化还原活性和结构稳定性。此外，结合紫外-可见光谱和分子对接的DNA结合研究揭示了双重相互作用模式（嵌入和沟槽结合），突显了它们在DNA靶向药物设计中的潜力。
